name: PTEN loss
summary: PTEN loss of function activates PI3K-AKT signalling, contributes to endocrine and PI3K-alpha inhibitor resistance, and is included in the biomarker definition for AKT inhibition.
biology: PTEN is a lipid phosphatase that dephosphorylates PIP3, opposing PI3K. Loss via mutation, deletion or epigenetic silencing increases AKT activity and shifts PI3K signalling towards the p110beta isoform, which explains reduced sensitivity to p110alpha-selective inhibitors.
alterations: Loss of protein expression by IHC

methods: Plasma ctDNA NGS (lower sensitivity for deletions)
testing.notes: Deletions are difficult to detect in ctDNA; tissue testing is preferred.

predictiveRelevance: PTEN alterations are included in the biomarker set selecting patients for capivasertib plus fulvestrant. PTEN loss is associated with resistance to alpelisib and other p110alpha-selective inhibitors.
resistance: Acquired PTEN loss as a mechanism of resistance to PI3K-alpha inhibitors
